fusions.name: Flushed Quarry
fusions.desc: Digs the target out of its armour, dealing 28 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Raised Hackles
fusions.desc: Bristles your scales and snaps at every enemy within 2.5 tiles, dealing 3 damage, with a 30% chance to leave each [Damped] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sentry Post
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holds their attention for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Brindle in Barding
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded hound that fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds and slowing what it bites by 15% for 2 seconds.
